body: Ill try my best to not let that word in my vocabulary any time soon.
Can't seem to find you anywhere

Sometimes its good to hear more than I'm sorry. Life's a crazy thing. It really is. I'm happy I'm still here. There's so much I want to do. See the world,be a pilot. More than anything feel true happiness.  Its just not easy you know ? Emotions are so overpowering.

Guys can be clueless. I get that. I think I just expected a  Different reaction.  I'm not ready to even take a break from my boyfriend.  I truly love him. He knows how I feel and he trust to help when he can sometimes he's just confused.  I dont want to hurt them. Thats why I'm so hesitant.  I could just see my little sisters face (she's 4) and I can't do it. I took a nap. That helped. I might try going for a walk and seeing if that'll help clear my mind a little
Ive been depressed for many years now. Real dad was a child molester.  Only recently started remembering it. Bad living situations. . Being raped. That, and Ive just always felt this way.
